Herry Porter Pembawa Cinta
programme.desc: Maya mencari kerja di Bandung dan tinggal di rumah budenya. Maya pun diterima bekerja di sebuah toko textil. Heri, seorang porter, bekerja di tempat yang sama. Mereka kerap bertengkar, tapi perlahan mereka menjadi dekat. Maya looked for a job in Bandung and stayed at her aunts house. Maya was accepted to work in a textile shop. Heri, a porter works at the same place. They often fight, but gradually they become close.n

programme.title: Cinta Lutung Kasarung
programme.desc: Rara yang culas dan ambisius kecewa ketika Sari terpilih sebagai pewaris utama Prabu. Rara bersekongkol dengan Indra tunangannya untuk menyingkirkan Sari dengan memberinya ramuan yang membuat kulitnya bersisik dan membuatnya harus bersembunyi di hutan. Unscrupulous and ambitious Rara feels disappointed when Sari is chosen as the heir of Prabu. Rara sets up a conspiracy with her fiance Indra to get rid of Sari by giving her a potion that makes her skin full of scales and force her to hide in the woods.n

programme.title: Cintaku Di Kejar Cicilan
programme.desc: Andre adalah pria tampan yang selalu bergaya dengan barang-barang mewah. Namun, semua itu dibeli Andre dengan berutang, akhirnya dia pun dikejar cicilan yang menumpuk. Andre is a handsome fellow who always looks stylish in luxurious goods. But actually he bought all of them in instalment. In the end, all of the bills backfires on him.n

programme.title: Harta Karun Nenek Bajak
programme.desc: Putri mempunyai kekasih yang terlibat hutang bernama Draco. Saat sedang terdesak dia teringat bahwa dia memiliki kenalan bernama Mira yang memiliki nenek kaya raya bernama Nenek Bajak di kampungnya. Putri menipu Nenek Bajak dengan mengaku dirinya Mira. Draco is Putris debt ridden boyfriend. Caught between a rock and a hard place, he remembers an acquintance named Mira who has a wealthy grandmother, Nenek Bajak, back in her hometown. Putri cons Nenek Bajak, claiming that she is Mira.n

programme.title: Factory Cinta
programme.desc: Karin melaksanakan tugas KKN di sebuah desa terpencil selama dua minggu. Merasa bosan, dia dan sahabatnya, Dinda, pergi ke kota untuk berbelanja tapi justru kemalingan dan tersesat. Lalu, Aman, pemuda desa yang ganteng datang menyelamatkannya. Karin carries out Community Service assignments in a remote village for two weeks. Be bored, she and her best friend, Dinda, go to town to shop but shes getting stolen and lost. Then, Aman, a handsome village youth, comes to save her.n

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat : Teko 1001 Malam
programme.desc: Rani, cewek cupu yang dirundung teman-temannya dan kerap mendapat perlakuan buruk. Ia juga mendapat perlakuan kasar dari tantenya. Rani menemukan sebuah teko usang, ketika digosok keluarlah sosok jin yang bisa mengabulkan tiga permintaan. Rani, a nerd girl gets bullied by her friends and often receives bad treatment. She also gets treated harshly from her aunt. Rani finds an old teapot, when the teapot was rubbed, a genie who can grant three wishes emerged.n

programme.title: 7 Pusaka - Sabuk Penghilang Raga
programme.desc: Raga adalah seorang maling kelas teri yang bernasib sial. Saat dikejar para warga dan bersembunyi di dalam sebuah kali, tiba-tiba Raga menemukan sebuah koin gobang yang hanyut. Saat Raga menggenggam koin itu, tiba-tiba saja ia menghilang. Raga is an unlucky petty thief. While he was hiding near the river from people who chase him, suddenly he found a gobang coin drifting. Raga holds the coin, and then he suddenly disappeared.n

programme.title: Ditinju Cinta
programme.desc: Meskipun ibunya melarang, Indah tetap ingin menjadi seorang petinju. Saat sanggar tinju mengeluarkannya karena kesalahan pengisian data, Indah belajar kepada seorang rekan sesama petinju. Dan cinta pun tumbuh di antara mereka berdua. Despite her mothers objection, Indah still wants to be a boxer. Currently thrown out of a boxing studio because of a data entry error, Indah keeps on practicing boxing with a fellow boxer. And love grows between them.n

programme.title: 7 Hari Kemudian
programme.desc: Mike, cowok playboy sekolah terkenal suka mempermainkan cewek. Fika mantan pacar Mike meninggal dunia karena bunuh diri. Amanda dan teman-temannya berencana membuat jera Mike. Mereka mengatur strategi bagaimana caranya menjebak Mike. Mike, the playboy at school is famous for playing with girls. Mikes ex-girlfriend Fika dies of suicide. Amanda and her friends plan to deter Mike. They also set a strategy how to trap Mike.n

programme.title: Misteri Sosok Sang Ibu
programme.desc: Iroh memiliki tiga anak, Sarah, Kanaya, dan Husein. Dia meninggal setelah terpeleset masuk ke kubangan air. Karena sang suami memiliki kemampuan memanggil arwah, Iroh dipanggil untuk menemani Husein tanpa diketahui anak-anaknya yang lain. Iroh had three children, Sarah, Kanaya and Husein. She died after a fall into the water well. Because of her husbands ability to summon spirits, he called Irohs spirit to accompany Hussein unbeknownst to the other children.n

programme.title: Ketemu Cinta Di Online Shop
programme.desc: Rayya adalah mahasiswa yang menekuni bisnis online. Dia mendapat saingan yaitu Pras, teman kampusnya yang juga punya bisnis toko online. Setelah kalah bersaing, Pras bekerja untuk Rayya, dan mereka saling jatuh cinta. Rayya is a college girl who runs an online business. Her business gets a rival, Pras, a friend in college who also started an online shop business. After failing to compete, Pras worked for Rayya, and in the end, they fall in love with each other.n

programme.title: Dunia Cermin
programme.desc: Vuri adalah siswi SMA yang menjadi bahan olok-olok dan ketinggalan dalam pelajaran sekolah. Hingga dia menemukan sebuah cermin yang membawanya ke dunia lain yang keadaannya berbeda 180 derajat dengan dunianya sekarang. Vuri is a high school student who has problems with her social life. Shes bullied and unable to keep up at school. Until she finds a magical mirror that took her to another realm that was 180 degrees different to her life now.n

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat Sepeda Onthel Badai
programme.desc: Guntur berencana membeli sepeda ontel di toko Kr.Amat yang katanya bisa melaju secepat cahaya hanya dengan sekali kayuh. Terbukti ketika Guntur mengayuh pedal tiba-tiba sepeda itu melesat sangat kencang lalu lenyap dalam sekejap. Guntur plans to buy a bicycle at Kr. Amat Store which was rumoured to be able to go as fast as the light. It is proven when Guntur paddles the bike and suddenly it races at the light speed and vanishes with a blink of an eye.n

programme.title: Radio Kabar Buruk
programme.desc: Kisah seorang wartawan yang sering membuat marah atasannya karena lambat bekerja dan selalu ketinggalan berita. Setelah menemukan radio antik di Toko Kr. Amat, dia selalu mengetahui semua peristiwa-peristiwa penting sebelum hal tersebut terjadi. This is a story of a journalist who often angered his boss because he always fails to hit the news. After getting an antique radio from Toko Kr. Amat, he always finds out about the important news even before it happened.n

programme.title: Cincin Wali
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda dari kota datang ke sebuah desa, dan melihat gadis yang pernah ditemuinya dalam mimpi. Dia memutuskan untuk tinggal di pesantren yang sama dengan gadis tersebut. Namun, untuk mendapatkan gadis itu dia harus memperoleh cincin wali. A young man from the town comes to a village, and sees the girl he had once met in a dream. He decides to stay in the same boarding school with the girl. However, to get the girl he has to obtain a ring of a wali.n

programme.title: Bangkitnya Rawa Rontek
programme.desc: Rontek, seorang pendekar jahat yang menguasai ilmu hitam bernama rawa rontek yang bisa menjadikannya kebal. Suatu ketika Rontek harus menghadapi lawan tangguh yang memiliki ilmu pancasona. Rontek is an evil warrior who has powerful black magic called rawa rontek that can make him invincible. One day, he has to face a tough opponent who wields a power called pancasona.n

programme.title: 7 Pusaka - Gasing Penghenti Waktu
programme.desc: Seorang penyanyi orkes melayu yang mulai kehilangan pamornya menemukan sebuah gasing bertuah yang dapat menghentikan waktu dan memakai kekuatan gasing itu untuk menghancurkan karier penyanyi baru saingannya yang cantik jelita. A Melayu orchestra singer who begins to lose her fame encounters a magical top that can stop the time and uses the power to destroy her rival, a beautiful young singer.n

programme.title: Kepentok Cinta Sementara
programme.desc: Arga diultimatum pihak kampus untuk melunasi biaya kuliah, Arga sama sekali tidak mempunyai uang. Beruntung ada Bonar yang bersedia meminjamkan uang, namun ada syaratnya yaitu, menjadi pacar sementara adiknya. Apakah Arga bersedia memenuhi syaratnya? Arga was given a warning by the campus to pay off his tuition fees, but Arga had absolutely no money. Luckily, there is Bonar, who is willing to lend money, but there is a condition: Arga must be willing to be his sisters temporary boyfriend. Will Arga agree?n

programme.title: OMG Aku Cinta Kamu
programme.desc: Bella, cewek cantik nan imut, pusing karena usahanya mengalami penurunan. Ini disebabkan oleh tukang cireng yang berjualan di samping toko miliknya. Ketika Bella ingin memarahi si penjual tersebut, dia justru terpukau oleh ketampanan penjual tersebut. Bella, a beautiful and cute girl, is dizzy because her business is declining. This is caused by a cireng seller who sells next to her shop. When Bella wants to scold the seller, she is instead captivated by his good looks.n

programme.title: Terdampar Di Pulau Kosong
programme.desc: Saat liburan semester Tomi mengajak teman-teman sekelas liburan di sebuah pulau. Tomi ajak Hani jalan-jalan dengan speedboat. Ditengah laut speedboat hilang kendali. Tomi milih selamatkan diri sendiri dan Hani ditinggal terdampar di pulau tak berpenghuni. On school holiday, Tomi and his classmates are going for a vacation in an island. Tomi takes Hani for a ride with speedboat. In the middle of the sea, his speedboat loses control. Tomi chooses to save himself and leaves Hani on a deserted island.n

programme.title: Cintaku Tak Seindah Ftv
programme.desc: Ada tetangga baru yang bikin Alya kepincut dengan ketampanannya. Ramzi, cowok ganteng dan keren itu bikin Alya penasaran. Alya seorang penulis FTV, kerap menulis cerita percintaan. Apakah kisah nyatanya bakal seindah cerita FTV? There is a new neighbor who makes Alya smitten with his good looks. Ramzi, the handsome and cool guy makes Alya curious. Alya, who is an FTV writer, often writes romance stories. Will the true story be as beautiful as the FTV story?n

programme.title: MJ Cantik
programme.desc: Jamilah pengagum berat Michael Jackson, memutuskan untuk melanjutkan sekolah di Jakarta agar bisa bertemu dengan idolanya, Fadly Jackson. Namun yang dia dapatkan adalah ejekan dan hinaan. Berhasilkah Jamilah mewujudkan impiannya? Jamilah is a big fan of Michael Jackson. She decides to continue her study in Jakarta in order to meet his idol, Fadly Jackson. However, what she got once she arrived there were mockeries and insults. Will Jamilah be able to achieve her dream?n

Ketika sang kekasih meninggalkannya dalam keadaan hamil, Key bertemu Handoko yang mengenalkannya pada cinta tanpa syarat. Key is a girl of Chinese descent who ran away from home and got involved in a romantic relationship with a man of a different ethnic group. When her lover dumped her while she was pregnant, Key met Handoko who showed her unconditional love.n

programme.title: PDKT Berbahaya
programme.desc: Untuk mendekati Alin, Egi memaksa teman-temannya, Sony dan Amanda, untuk berlibur ke kampung halaman Alin. On their way there, they decided to take a forbidden path and they encountered many strange events that made them experienced bad luck.n

programme.title: Jubah Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Sinta adalah gadis cantik dan ambisius dari keluarga kurang mampu. Setelah menemukan Jubah Tak Kasat Mata di toko Kr. After finding Invisibility Cloak in Toko Kr. Amat, she sneaks into Poppys house and steals some money from the vault. Unbeknownst to her, the robe brings curse to the person who wears it.n

programme.title: Kecantol Derek Cinta

Mona and Ryan met over an encounter that took her breath away, or to more precise, tow her car away because she parked illegally. Will their story end here?n

programme.desc: Lila adalah anak yatim yang bekerja sebagai penjahit. Saat sedang mengantarkan hasil jahitan, dia menabrak motor Robby. Sebagai ganti rugi, Lila harus berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya. Seiring waktu berjalan, tumbuh rasa cinta di antara mereka. Lila is an orphan girl who works as a tailor. When delivering her works for her customers, she hits Robbys motorcycle. To make amends, Robby asks Lila to pretend to be his girlfriend. As time goes by, love grows between the two of them.n

One day, he robbed a house and took a fancy chest. He thought it was a chest containing a lot of jewelries and money. But apparently, it holds something very different from what he is expected.n

programme.desc: Sally adalah idola kampus yang diperebutkan oleh Sam dan Sony. Sementara Sally hanya menyukai Bambang. programme.title: Dihatiku Ada Kamu
programme.desc: Rian tanya kenapa Adif dan Afeeq datang ke butiknya. Afeeq risau, Rian marah sebab sibuk nak tahu hal dia. Adif juga tak suka cara Rian, lalu bawa Rian pulang. Adif, tanya tentang siapa Indri. Rian dan Adif bergaduh . Afeeq tanya Indri tentang hubungan dengan Rian. Indri kata dia tak ganggu isteri orang, tapi Afeeq tetap beri amaran. Rian beritahu Adif dia nak ke Vietnam urusan kerja. Rian tak mahu jumpa Adif lagi sebab dia dah penat nak layan semua kerenah dan cemburu Adif. Tarikh dua bulan sudah hampir dan ia buatkan Adif susah hati sebab Rian sudah menjauhinya semula. Fitrin tunggu Adif, ugut akan ganggu keluarga jika Adif tak jumpa dia. Adif marah, cekak leher Fitrin. Faisal datang, Adif lepaskan Fitrin dan pergi. Adif memandu laju ke sekolah Farhan, risau sesuatu berlaku. Dia terlanggar tembok selepas mengelak kereta lain. Adif cedera, Rian terkejut dan apabila Rian pulang ke Malaysia, Farhan sudah ikut Adif dan Adif mahu ambil Farhan. Rian mengaku dia salah sangka dan tuduh Adif macam macam. Mereka bergaduh besar sehingga Adif hampir melafazkan cerai tapi Rian cuba merayu.

Tetapi terlebih dahulu, dia perlu menyelesaikan satu misi terakhir - walaupun itu bermakna dia perlu menguruskan dua tugas paling sukar setakat ini: memburu pengganas paling kejam di dunia dan menjaga anak perempuannya yang remaja buat pertama kali dalam sepuluh tahun, sementara isterinya tiada di bandar.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP6
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Bayu memberitahu Lisa, doktor Caryl yang menghadiahkan jam tersebut kepadanya. Jenama yang sama pernah dihadiahkan oleh Caryl kepadanya. Perkara tersebut dikongsikan oleh Lisa dengan Afifa. Mbah Nira minta Bakri dibawa ke rumahnya untuk diubati. Lisa terdengar perbulan Caryl dengan Azhar semasa berada di klinik, nama Bakri dan Nasrun disebut sebagai ahli kumpulan mereka. Lisa dan Syamil telah mengenali setiap ahli Kumpulan Hunter, namun mereka perlu mendapatkan Pak Samad untuk dijadikan saksi sebelum bertindak membuat laporan polis. Walaupun Afifa mendesak supaya tindakan segera diambil. Manakala Nasrun menghubungi Syamil bagi membantunya. Syamil dan Lisa ke rumah Pak Samad, malangnya mereka mendapati Pak Samad telah mati membunuh diri.

programme.title: The Equalizer S3 EP8

programme.desc: Sekumpulan rakan menyiasat kejadian aneh di sebuah vila dengan bilik keluarga misteri. Pertemuan ghaib mereka membawa kepada peningkatan keganasan selepas kesilapan seorang ahli, mendedahkan rahsia gelap tentang masa lalu seorang nenek yang lumpuh.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP1
programme.desc: Imbas kembali 12 tahun lalu di sebuah Kg Kuala Pari Hilir. Tiga kanak-kanak bersahabat iaitu Yeh Kumbang, Gani Gagap dan Li Kelubi perlu melintasi rumah Wan Peah selepas mengaji Quran. Wan Peah dikatakan seorang yang misteri, tinggal sendirian, mengamal ilmu hitam dan sering mengganggu kanak-kanak ini. Tok Hashim sebagai ketua kampung mempunyai seorang anak lelaki bernama Faan yang selalu bermain dengan Yeh, Gani dan Li. Suatu hari semasa bermain menyorok berhampiran dengan rumah Wan Peah, Faan dia telah dibawa lari oleh Wan Peah masuk ke rumahnya.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP2
programme.desc: Siti seorang ibu tunggal bersama anaknya Aishah dan adiknya Yurin baru berpindah ke Kg Sg Kuala Pari Hilir. Siti akan mengajar sekolah berhampiran. Bagaimanapun, kehadirannya tidak disenangi oleh Cikgu Zaiton, juga guru di sekolah itu. Kumbang mengajak Gani Gagap dan Li meniaga ikan masin. Ketika berniaga, mereka mendapat tahu Cikgu Siti tinggal berhampiran dengan rumah Wan Peah.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP3
programme.desc: Sedang Nurin leka, dia mendapati Aisyah tiada dipangkuannya. Nurin menjadi takut. Dia cuba mencari Aisyah disekitar kawasan kampung. Aishah hilang semasa Nurin keluar dengan Yeh Kumbang. Mereka mula mencari Aishah. Cik Siti yang sedang mengajar di sekolah terkejut dengan berita yang dibawa oleh orang kampung.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP4
programme.desc: Yeh, Gani dan Li percaya yang Wan Peah ada ilmu hitam sebab lembaga Wan Peah muncul di rumah mereka. Tok Hashim mahu memagar dengan ilmunya dan percaya Siti ada kaitan dengan misteri Wan Peah sejak dia berpindah dan Siti perlu dihalau segera. Prestasi kerja Siti semakin menurun, Cikgu Zaiton mengambil kesempatan memburukkan Siti.

Syamil datang ke rumah Bakri selepas dihubungi oleh Nasrun bagi mengubati sakit Bakri, malangnya Azhar terlebih dahulu membawa Bakri ke rumah Mbah Nira untuk memulihkannya. Kesempatan itu digunakan oleh Afifa bagi menggunakan ilmu hitam secara dalaman ke atas Bakri, walaupun pada fizikalnya Bakri telah disembuhkan oleh Mbah Nira. Lisa marahkan Afifa kerana melepaskan Bakri dan Azhar balik kerana peluang yang ada tidak digunakan bagi mereka membalas dendam. Di rumah, Bakri sekali lagi di rasuk sehingga hampir membunuh Azhar. Nasrun terpaksa menghubungi Syamil untuk memulihkan Bakri dengan menggunakan pendekatan Islamik. Akibatnya, Afifa terkesan dan hampir mati.

programme.title: Losmen Melati EP5
programme.desc: Melati mendedahkan niat sebenar dia yang ingin mengembalikan anaknya dari kematian. Dengan bantuan seorang Bomoh, Watih, Melati akan membawa pulang anaknya menggunakan darah yang dicuri daripada tetamu mudanya yang telah meninggal dunia sebelum ini. Namun, bukan anaknya sahaja yang ingin dibawa pulang. Melati telah membuat keputusan untuk membawa kembali Sigit - lelaki yang dibesarkannya, seorang lelaki yang mempunyai masa lalu yang kelam dan tragis - Melati percaya bahawa di sebalik kengerian masa lalunya, dia layak mendapat peluang kedua. Makhluk jahat yang pernah terperangkap di ruang bawah tanah didedahkan di Kusno, makhluk jahat dan jahat serta bapa Sigit. Apabila Kusno mula membunuh, dia mula menjadi lebih kuat dan mula menyerupai bentuk manusianya sekali lagi. Kusno mempunyai satu misi - untuk memusnahkan Melati. Tetapi Kusno tidak bersendirian. Dengan menggunakan kuasanya yang semakin meningkat, dia memihak kepada bentuk jahat lelaki yang membunuh ibu Melati pada tahun 1900-an - Pemburu.

programme.title: Bayi Tabung
programme.desc: Setelah mengharungi satu peristiwa yang menghimpit kehidupan, Jelina ditawarkan untuk menyewakan rahimnya dengan bayaran tinggi oleh sepasang suami isteri dari Malaysia yang tidak punya anak secara biasa. Tawaran harga yang tinggi membuatkan Jelina bersetuju untuk menerima titipan embrio itu sehingga lahir. Setelah bayi itu lahir timbul pula satu masalah kerana Jelina merasa bahawa bayi itu adalah darah dagingnya.

programme.title: Pagar-Pagar Cinta
programme.desc: Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dihadapi Bidin dan Ani kerana cinta antara dua darjat. Bidin, anak orang kaya manakala Ani hanyalah seorang yang biasa-biasa sahaja. Ibu Bidin ingin menjodohkannya dengan Rita, anak kepada kenalannya yang kaya-raya. Berbagai cara terpaksa dilakukan oleh Bidin untuk menyakinkan bahawa Ani lah pilihan hatinya. Berjayakah rancangan Bidin untuk melembutkan hati ibunya?

programme.title: Anak Niat
programme.desc: Juita dipanggil anak niat yang ditatah penuh kasih sayang oleh ibu dan bapanya, Orang Kaya dan Faridah. Ibu dan bapa Juita bernazar kepada Keramat untuk mendapatkan seorang anak iaitu Juita namun tidak mahu menerima kenyataan bahawa perbuatan itu adalah syirik. Juita kemudian menjalinkan hubungan bersama Jidot. Abang Mat pula sedih kerana sering dipandang hina oleh Orang Kaya dan Juita hanya kerana dia seorang pembantu yang diupah oleh mereka. Kebenaran terbongkar apabila Abang Mat ialah bapa kepada Jidot dan juga Juita.

programme.title: Cinta Kita
programme.desc: Patah hati setelah dicurangi teman lelakinya, Remy, Latifah mengubah penampilannya menjadi seorang tomboy. Sukar untuknya mempercayai lelaki, dia pun berpindah ke tempat lain. Perkenalannya bersama Arman, seorang penulis novel mengubah kembali cara Latifah yeng berpenampilan lelaki. Hubungan mereka yang semakin rapat menimbulkan perasaan cinta.

programme.title: Bintang Pujaan
programme.desc: Rina dan Hassan mencintai antara satu sama lain namun hubungan mereka mulai retak. Ini kerana Rina ingin meneruskan kerjayanya sebagai seorang penyanyi dan pelakon. Hassan pula mendapat kerja baru di syarikat pembinaan milik Nancy. Percintaan Rina dan Hassan kembali mekar dan mereka pun berkahwin. Namun, satu insiden yang menimpa Hassan telah mengubah hidup mereka.

programme.title: Jejaka Perasan
programme.desc: Dolah dan Dolit, masing-masing telah dihalau dari rumah oleh ibu dan isteri kerana malas bekerja dan gemar bermain judi kuda. Mereka pun menyewa bilik di rumah Pak Wok. Pak Wok tinggal bersama anaknya Rizan yang sedang bercinta dengan Amir. Mereka ditawarkan bekerja sebagai tukang cuci oleh Dato Kamarul kerana telah membantu membaiki kereta anaknya, Dora. Mulalah tersebar cerita bahawa mereka merupakan pegawai tetapi sebenarnya tidak.

programme.title: Bertunang
programme.desc: Darus ingin dikahwini dengan Zarinah, anak pengurus bank oleh bapa saudaranya - dia merupakan seorang yang kaya-raya. Namun, Darus melarikan diri kerana dia enggan mengahwini Zarinah dan sudah mempunyai kekasih hati. Mengetahui tujuan bapa saudaranya ingin menjodohkannya bersama anak seorang pengurus bank untuk membiayai projeknya, Darus hilang membawa diri - tetapi bapa saudaranya mempunyai rancangannya yang tersendiri.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

programme.title: Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: Highly influenced by western culture, couple LUK SHUI-FUNG Raymond Wong and LAW KWAI-SZE Grace Chan want to reshape their feudal hometown, Ping On Valley, which has fallen so far behind, but nothing comes out as they wish. Not only are they under the tyrannical dictatorship of their father, Village Chief LUK KAM-KUK Lau Kong, who constantly stands in their way, but they are also involved in the ghost bride murder mystery, kidnapping and homicide respectively. Victims of bullying including KAM-KUKs concubines SUNG MING-FUNG Louisa So and KOO MAN-YEE Rebecca Zhu, and maid TIN CHOR-YAT Katy Kung eventually cant take it anymore. Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN Louis Yuen bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. Cantopop At 50 invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: The Gallant Gent - Patrick Tse
programme.desc: Patrick Tse, a legendary figure in Hong Kongs film and television industry, known as Brother Four, passed away in mid-July due to illness. A leading man since the era of Cantonese films, he captivated audiences with his handsome looks and superb acting skills, his career spanning film, television, and variety shows, maintaining his charm for decades. In the hearts of viewers, Brother Four was forever dashing and debonair, a highly charismatic male star. His starring roles in dramas such as The King of Gamblers and The Legend of the Condor Heroes created many memorable characters. This special feature reviews Patrick Tses acting career, revisits classic moments, and, through the memories of friends like Liza Wang and Fung Bo-bo, reminisces about Brother Fours dashing life.

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature
programme.desc: Taiwans camping destinations are breathtaking! Hong Kong host Lin Yinghui, along with three of Taiwans goddesses Lin Xiang, Zhang Yahan, and Huang Shangyan, embarked on a nature-themed healing trip. They traversed Nantou, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan, and other locations, delving into the Miaoli mountains, trying out forest cabins, luxury campervans, deluxe tents, and even camping at a baseball stadium Surrounded by mountains, they enjoyed open-air hot springs, watched the sunset at the beach, explored historical sites near the campsites, and immersed themselves in nature. Finally, they returned to Yangmingshan in Taipei for camping, soaking in hot springs, and overlooking the unparalleled night view of Taipei! Besides experiencing the unique atmosphere of camping, what sparks will fly between the Taiwanese and Hong Kong women as they interact and bond?

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: News Perspective is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: My Family Legacy Sr.2
programme.desc: My Family Legacy II is a documentary reality series that takes TVB celebrities out of the spotlight and places them directly into the demanding, gritty workplaces of their parents. This season explores both local traditional trades and international family legacies. By enduring the grueling physical labor, long hours, and high pressure their parents quietly faced for decades, these celebrities uncover deep family memories and gain a profound appreciation for parental sacrifice.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN Lau Dan built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI Koni Lui, is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE Andrea So, often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Journey to Jianghu SR.2 Whats On Today
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Reading ten thousand books is not as good as traveling ten thousand miles. Wayne Lai and Mak Cheung-ching embark on another journey, continuing their exploration of the magnificent landscapes depicted in Jin Yongs novels and delving into the martial arts world of Chinese history. They travel along the Yangtze and Yellow River basins, traversing Sichuan, Zhejiang, Henan, and Shanxi provinces, climbing Mount Emeis Golden Summit, visiting Baidi City, the Yue Fei Temple in Zhuxian Town, and exploring the Shaolin Temple on Mount Song. They experienced the weight of historical sites and savored local delicacies. The martial arts world is not only a stage for swords and shadows, but also a realm of intertwined human relationships. During their journey, they also reunited with Michelle Yim, Benny Chan, Louis Fan, and Jackie Lui, reminiscing about their past collaborations and laughing about bygone days.

However, when desires get out of line due to pure greed for money and power, or even fanciful lust, so much so that whimsical imaginings are infinitely exaggerated. And unintentionally, you just fall into the abyss of moral dilemma and commit all kinds of Deadly Sins. Crime Unit, New Territories East investigates successive cases, including Faceless Corpse, Stone Coffin, 100 Million Motive for Murder, Dangerous Game, Dirty Bullet and Terrifying Lover. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: The Inner Eye Whats On Today
programme.desc: When The Inner Eye follows Shenzhen lawyer Tang Yingying as she handles a series of controversial cases and gradually transforms from someone driven by victory and profit into a lawyer who rediscovers her professional conscience. Through cases involving sexual assault allegations, inheritance disputes, emotional and medical conflicts, domestic violence, and public opinion against lawyers, she witnesses the darkness and vulnerability of human nature. As the lives of Dai Peilin, Lin Xiaoyun, Kang Jun, Fang Weian and others intertwine with hers, Tang learns to cover her eyes and listen to her inner sense of justice and integrity, ultimately finding her own rebirth in law, love and life.

programme.title: Journey to Jianghu SR.2
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Reading ten thousand books is not as good as traveling ten thousand miles. Wayne Lai and Mak Cheung-ching embark on another journey, continuing their exploration of the magnificent landscapes depicted in Jin Yongs novels and delving into the martial arts world of Chinese history. They travel along the Yangtze and Yellow River basins, traversing Sichuan, Zhejiang, Henan, and Shanxi provinces, climbing Mount Emeis Golden Summit, visiting Baidi City, the Yue Fei Temple in Zhuxian Town, and exploring the Shaolin Temple on Mount Song. They experienced the weight of historical sites and savored local delicacies. The martial arts world is not only a stage for swords and shadows, but also a realm of intertwined human relationships. During their journey, they also reunited with Michelle Yim, Benny Chan, Louis Fan, and Jackie Lui, reminiscing about their past collaborations and laughing about bygone days.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Walking With You
programme.desc: Sharon Chan, Samantha Ko, Katy Kung, and Grace Chan are close friends in the entertainment industry. This trip to Malaysia was a rare girls getaway, filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. They visited durian orchards to enjoy fresh Musang King durians, picked vegetables and coconuts in vegetable gardens, explored the rainforest, and visited luxurious houses, experiencing a different side of Malaysia. The four friends also shared heartfelt conversations with their guests, revealing their true selves.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Winter Night
programme.desc: Zheng Daqian Qiao Xin, a struggling office worker suffering setbacks in both love and career due to urban lifes hardships, receives compensation for the demolition of her hometown in Northeast China and embarks on a journey back. A geomagnetic storm caused by a fireball leaves her train stranded in the wilderness. Witnessing the fireball, Zheng Daqian is shocked to find herself transported to a parallel universe! There, she encounters her deceased father, her mother who left despite never divorcing her, and her childhood friend and lost first love, Mu Zili Ma Sichao! Unable to return to her original world, Zheng Daqian seizes this opportunity to make amends for her past regrets, and the seeds of a budding romance with Mu Zili begin to sprout with the arrival of spring. Unfortunately, the fireball reappears, and Zheng Daqian and Mu Zili are destined to become lovers separated by two worlds, unable to touch each other!

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Across the Strait
programme.desc: The Across the Strait traces the much-discussed issues across the Strait, reflects the will of the citizens on two sides of the Strait and details the Chinese Governments policy of one country, two systems in a bid to enhance the Taiwan fellowmens understanding of the Mainland China.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: This show focuses on the issues that are most important to urban modern women. It combines current events with discussions of lifes major and minor problems and invites various specialists to address various difficulties. Netizens will occasionally attend the show to share their own stories and ask questions of the guests and experts, making the topics more relevant and audience-focused!

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages. Its goals include discovering grassroots talent, innovating Taiwanese song performance styles, and involving more local talent in song composition to infuse new life into Taiwanese music.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: After surviving the Heavenly Lightning Strike, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing persist, but their mortal forms lie in ruins. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them using the Seven-Colored Lotus, yet countless perils loom over the process. As enemies close in and fate hangs in the balance, can they reclaim their bodies and rewrite their destiny?

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Adapted from a famous Hong Kong comic, Tiger Wong is ambushed after he unwittingly took the Lousha Plaque but is saved by his brother Dragon Wong. They also befriended Turbo Shek during the fight and the trio forms a brotherhood. To avenge the death of the Dragon Gate masters, they train and vow to defeat Shibumi, the leader of Lousha Clan.

programme.title: S Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk witnesses a suspects murder while investigating an illegal soccer gambling case, but is unable to disclose information to Chief Inspector Lau due to his code of confidentiality, thereby hindering Laus investigation. While starting the case with mutual distrust, they end up reaching a rapport to uproot the crime syndicate.

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his fathers heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Septet: The Story of Hong Kong
programme.desc: Seven of Hong Kongs most revered directors, all with distinctly unique styles, come together for the first time to compose a symphony of stories for their city from the 50s to the future.

programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Lei Yu has officially become the new generation of Chinese test pilots after rounds of strict selection. Captain Zhang Ting leads Lei Yu and other pilots to test the latest fighter jets. Lei Yu keeps pushing the limits in each test flight in the hope of coming up with the perfect plane to ensure the safety of the fighter pilots.

programme.title: Where The Wind Blows
programme.desc: Founded in the 70s, Hong Kongs ICAC is committed to fight corruption in the police force. Detectives Lui Lok and Nam Kong build a corruption system that creates conflicts between the triad and the police. When ICAC hunts down the two, their control finally comes to an end. Where the wind blows, Hong Kong is no longer what it used to be!

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: YUM is a detective agency that handles supernatural cases. As YUM investigates the evil spirits appearing in an old building, they discover that the spirits are created by a spirit master to haunt the residents so that the building can be vacated for redevelopment. Can the YUM investigators finally find ways to fight against the master?

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three womens lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families. From the struggles at home to challenges in relationships and conflicts at work, these three women rise with strength when faced with plights unknown.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from Tos father and bitter jealousy from her designated fianc, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Lius investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: 13 year-old Fen is uprooted from LA and moves to Taipei in early 2003, when her mother is diagnosed with breast cancer. She struggles to adjust to her new life with a new school and long-separated father, and drifts away from her mother. When her younger sister is misdiagnosed with SARS, they finally open up to each other during quarantine.

programme.title: Z Storm
programme.desc: ICAC Chief Officer Luk is on the case of a corrupt policeman but finds all key witnesses killed when he starts to discover some clues. As investigation continues, Luk uncovers the fraud scheme of an organized corrupt group involving the governments 15 billion Care Fund. He must fight against them to keep Hong Kong corruption free.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Directed by Ann Hui, the movie is adapted from Eileen Changs first short story. Set in 1930s, Wei Long travels to Hong Kong from Shanghai to pursue her education. Struggling financially, she asks her aunt to help pay for tuition but ends up being her aunts puppet to lure rich men. When Wei Long falls for playboy, George, she sinks into a life of depravity.

programme.title: Sifu VS Vampire
programme.desc: This is a horror comedy about Sifu, Charlie Jiang, and his team of vampire hunters taking on the Vampire King who has been let loose on the streets of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Ready Or Rot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi are finally getting married but pressure from Guys mother creates much friction between them. Meanwhile, Grey Bear suspects his wife of cheating on him and Ken faces the biggest crisis of his life when Jessica accidentally gets pregnant. Can they eventually solve their relationship problems?

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: A group of bounty hunters, including San, Yo, Cat, Swan and Bobo, are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings that have plagued an international hotel group. Unfortunately, Swan, Cat and Bobo are kidnapped by the mastermind of the bombings. Can San and Yo save them? Will the bounty hunters accomplish their mission?

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her familys massacre years ago.

programme.title: The House Of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Yings father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt Shaolin Hand Lock from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Lings house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld Kings sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says I do?

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperors sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wongs caught in the Mongs territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Pings limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy House of 72 tenants, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yangs escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own Eight Diagram Pole Fight and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chiefs illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his fathers death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Lis wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Lis Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mothers death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chans family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chans daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: Na Cha The Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend Investiture of the Gods, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping Irene Chen I-ling and Pai-hung Betty Ting Pei and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yens property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love

programme.title: Kishkindapuri
programme.desc: During a ghost tour, visitors enter a radio station and awaken a dormant spirit. Trapped inside, they must find a way out as supernatural forces threaten them.

programme.title: Balle Khilladi
programme.desc: An amnesiac scientist, is in love with Nandana, who is unaware of his condition. Things take a turn when he has to convince her parents.

programme.title: Veeran

南非味覺之路
programme.desc: Sprawling across the northern border of South Africa, is the stunning Madikwe Game Reserve. In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog. From stunning locations at the Madikwe Safari Lodge with Rhinos and Giraffes looking on!, hell cook a South African inspired dessert and a risotto like no other, topping it all off with a sunset feast in the bush. An unmissable episode for the adventurous!

programme.title: 扭轉味蕾
programme.desc: A Nashville Hot Chicken served as a Bloody Mary? A grilled cheese sandwich dessert? French Onion Soup but its a pretzel? Chefs around America today are coming up with amazing twists on our favorite classic dishes. A panel of charismatic celebrity chefs and culinary influencers reveal where you can find the zaniest, where in the heck did they come up with that? Delicious spins on familiar dishes.

programme.title: Britains Got Talent S17
programme.desc: A variety of acts perform in front of a live audience and a panel of judges for a chance to win 250,000 and perform for the British Royal Family at the Royal Variety Performance.

programme.title: 百萬歌詞記憶王
programme.desc: Contestants get their musical memory challenged in a bid to win 1 million. Theyll sing alongside the studio band, but suddenly the music will stop, and the words will disappear. Will they sing missing lyrics, or freeze under pressure?

programme.title: The Murderous Scissor Sisters
programme.desc: This follows one of Irelands bloodiest and most notorious crimes. On the 30th March 2005, police were called to the banks of Dublins Royal Canal after reports of body parts found floating in the water. Detectives arrived on the scene and began their investigation which brought them across the globe, and ultimately to the door of the Mulhall family. Linda and Charlotte Mullhall, dubbed the Scissor Sisters due to the barbarity of the crime, stabbed and dismembered their mothers partner, Farah Swaleh Noor and dumped his headless body into the canal. The crime horrified yet captivated the nation. This docu-series forensically examines this crime, along with the aftermath that it left in its wake.

programme.title: Gus the Itsy Bitsy Knight S2
programme.desc: Gus, there was a little boy who wanted to become The Greatest knight in the whole kingdom of Karamel. The problem is, Gus is - ITSY BITSY. Gus will prove to one and all that a brave heart can overcome everything.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S8
programme.desc: Its time to get tiny for some a-meow-zing new dollhouse adventures! Hop aboard the S.S. MerCat with Gabby and her friends as they sail to never before seen magical places, meeting new cats at every turn. Go to Mermaid-lantis with MerCat and her sister SunnyCat, build a rainbow igloo at the North Pole, and welcome Baby Box Cats new little brother to the dollhouse family. They may not have all the answers...Yet!, but the Gabby Cats are always ready to give it a go! Bringing together adorable kitties, dollhouse play, growth mindset, music, crafts, and laughs Gabbys Dollhouse is the preschool show... with a surprise inside!

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 學神出沒注意
programme.desc: 今集學神出沒注意派出兩位愛鬥大的學神代表阿神及Leanne考牌！阿神處男下海為節目奉上人生第一次，Leanne則以低胸短裙迎戰地獄教車師傅！二人由筆試鬥到模擬測試，當中錯漏百出，水皮情況難分高下！見二人氣勢嚴重受挫，節目組特意安排神秘驚喜，家姐Ranya帶Leanne坐旅居車Camping；造星好兄弟Klau及Wallis則帶阿神夜遊車河，為二人學車打打氣！

programme.title: 聲的築城者

programme.title: 夜漫遊
programme.desc: Yoshi同Anton為咗食成都嘅隱世西班牙餐廳，竟然特登搭個幾鐘車，去到海拔超過1000米嘅龍泉山頂？之後Anton仲帶Yoshi去減肥，不過兩位唔係去做gym，而係去近年興起嘅室內場玩極限運動！Yoshi仲玩到嗌哂媽咪想提早放工？最後兩位仲搵到源於成都嘅正宗麻婆豆腐，一邊感受舌尖上嘅麻香，一邊欣賞川劇變臉同埋長嘴銅壺茶藝！

programme.title: 適者生存
programme.desc: 在一晚露宿野外的體驗後，女孩們對生火砍柴採集野菜熟練許多，特別是蔡宛珊更是精通生火，可以稱為這趟野外求生的火神，而米露迪製作的魚簍雖然只撈到了泥沙，但得到了教練稱讚製作的非常精緻，每個學員跟一開始什麼都不懂的自己比起來，都成長到能在不同的求生項目獨當一面，這次寶貴的野外求生經驗，讓女孩們留下深刻的回憶！

programme.title: 腦霧研究所
programme.desc: 相信對於男士嚟講，要分辨汽車嘅種類同性能絕對唔係難題，但今集腦霧研究所派出嘅三位挑戰者Shirley Kenji同Kaying都係無牌之人，對車嘅認識非常貧乏！三位要跟車行達人取經，並要進行一連串認車大考驗！除咗要認汽車儀表板警示之外，仲要學人聽引擎聲，仲有個第一個設有對話嘅NPC模擬情境題！希望三位可以順順利利過關啦！

programme.title: COLLAR智慧學園
programme.desc: COLLAR智慧學園終極決戰，對戰雙方實力旗鼓相當：一位喺節目初期，已經被譽為冠軍大熱門，之後就更加不負重望，以長勝姿態，過關斬將殺入決賽；另一位雖然因為最初表現失準而被淘汰，但係成功翻生之後就愈戰愈勇，堪稱敗者復活嘅傳奇！喺智慧嘅終極擂台上面，佢哋唔單止要鬥智鬥策略，仲要識捉心理同考勇氣！邊個信念唔夠強，隨時就將冠軍寶座拱手相讓！

programme.title: 駐港家鄉味
programme.desc: 一想起法國，就聯想到法式高級美食! 今集，法國駐香港總領事Christine，會帶同兩位主持去品嚐法國家鄉味道，感受法國菜的優雅情調與浪漫兩位主持絞盡腦汁，不甘示弱，帶領事去可能是香港最elegant的茶館，品嘗中式雅緻情懷

programme.title: 放學玩啲咩
programme.desc: 很多朋友認識跆拳道這種運動都是通過奧運會，但是你們又知不知跆拳道是在何時開始呢？跆拳道的基本裝備有哪些，一些基本動作又有哪些今集就帶大家了解跆拳道

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 香港正在急速構建國際黃金交易中心，投資推廣署署長劉凱旋接受大鳴大放專訪表示，洪水橋的產業園區有23公頃地，署方正洽談數間金商，包括有店舖的大型機構，早前已協助一間瑞士公司在港開設地區總部劉凱旋舉例其中一間公司是瑞士MKS PAMP，以往在美國經Costco超市銷售大量金條，投資推廣署協助MKS在港開設地區總部，該公司會研究進一步的發展另外，還有一些中資企業有很大規模的黃金交易，亦有零售店舖，正了解香港的營商環境等她指投資推廣署的身份尤如客戶經理，內地叫做店小二，主要任務是招商引資，協助企業落戶香港，了解客戶的投資及帶來的就業情況產業性質等；並以香港作為平台再發展海外市場，協助客戶對接不同的政策局或園區另外，劉凱旋指投資推廣署配合政府政策，將客戶意見收集後反饋一些建議給相關政策局，優化香港的營商環境香港黃金中央清算及結算系統於7月7日正式試營運，已有11間大型金融機構参與她表示投資推廣署聯絡不少金商或金融機構，而該些金商或機構傳統上在倫敦黃金交易所或其他市場進行交易，不過隨着亞太地區對金的需求及相關投資越來越多，在香港倉儲黃金由以前200噸，政府宣布在三年內實現增至2000噸黃金倉儲容量，劉凱旋指有金融機構向她們反映，在整個黃金交易生態圈，包括零售金條金幣都需要在香港進行交易，正好黃金清算系統融合北都發展，可在北都設黃金儲倉，以至煉金廠等她續指港交所有黃金期貨ETF等豐富的生態圈，投資推廣署和財庫局一起引入多些金商來港，並與發展局緊密合作，洪水橋的產業園區有23公頃地，她透露會有金商進駐，亦有研究機構高端產業例如藥業等等劉凱旋表示香港背靠祖國是中國的地方，資金自由流動法律和語言體系對接國際，有專業的律師或會計服務等各種優勢，海內外資金以香港作為一個風險管理中心金融中心的平台，她說:內地有句說法是不出海就出局，我提醒他們，你亂出海就會出事，例如在海外的資金忽然會被國有化

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 香港非物質文化遺產清單有超過500個項目，處身轉變時代，不少面臨邊緣化，甚至失傳的危機位於上水古洞超過80年歷史的悅和醬園，主要製作傳統生曬豉油，這項釀造技藝於2014年被列入為香港非遺項目2011年，政府公布北部都會區發展策略，醬園廠房屬於發展區範圍，面臨收地問題，醬園負責人指，需要自行尋找合適土地搬遷，不過過程困難重重南音是廣東地區的傳統說唱曲藝，2014年被列入香港非遺清單，更是24個非遺代表作名錄之一；隨著娛樂多元化，南音的表演機會越來越少，有研究南音的學者認為，可以善用不同媒介推廣傳統表演藝術，例如電影破．地獄加入了南音元素，演唱客途秋恨和遊十殿，大眾會更容易認知和接受白鐵器具透過敲打折疊的方式，把鐵片緊密摺合，這項技藝同樣於2014年被列入為非遺項目白鐵防銹質量輕，而且價廉耐用，上世紀六七十年代是香港白鐵行業的黃金時期，不過隨著塑膠不鏽鋼等物料製品日漸普及，加上內地生產的家品輸入香港，本地白鐵製品需求不斷下降，有白鐵師傅便把這種傳統工藝，融合現代生活元素，製作有特色的日用品首飾和藝術裝置，爭取生存空間非遺項目要保育傳承，可以怎樣做？如何做？

programme.title: 一路camp 一路遊
programme.desc: 夜宿特色營房，眾人圍著溝火大玩煙花隔天親手採摘鮮甜玉米，並探訪精釀啤酒廠膽大主持更挑戰奇特草蜢雪糕！在前往第五個營地前，團隊特別到訪神祕的Zero磁場領域，吸滿大自然正能量

programme.title: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 血友病的病人天生有凝血功能問題，到底他們的日常該如何護理？今集主持強尼米露迪Ash，找來Eric一起請教醫生！到底血友病能否醫治，患者又能如何應對？

programme.title: 爆谷一周
programme.desc: ViuTV 溫情劇日落下的彩虹用嶄新筆觸去紀錄社區重建前的最美餘光，因此今集請來導演劉偉恒與演員潘燦良阿Day（許軼），還有首度參演本台劇集的視后唐詩詠，在節目深情對話又激情討論劇集主打溫情，是否只剩既有套路暴走展開才是新出路？各台演員又是否自帶台風？妙語如珠，萬勿錯過！

programme.title: CHILL CLUB

programme.title: 蠟筆小新

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.
